template.name: Lugares de Interés - Listado

div.p: Descubre y comparte las historias de Guanarteme
Haz clic en 'Editar' para añadir contenido aquí

span.class: badge bg-info text-dark px-3 py-2 d-inline-block text-truncate

div.class: products_header btn-toolbar flex-wrap align-items-center justify-content-between gap-2 p-3 bg-light rounded mb-4

t.t-esc: [c for c in categorias if c['id'] == categoria_filter][0]['name']

div.class: card h-100 border-0 shadow-sm overflow-hidden card-hover

button.class: position-absolute top-0 end-0 m-2 btn btn-light btn-sm rounded-circle like-btn shadow-sm

a.t-att-href: '/lugares-de-interes?page=' + str(page - 1) + ('&search=' + search if search else '') + ('&categoria=' + str(categoria_filter) if categoria_filter else '') + ('&ordenar=' + str(ordenar) if ordenar else '') + ('&limit=' + str(limit) if limit and limit != 12 else '') + '#entries_grid'

'/lugares-de-interes?page=' + str(p) + ('&search=' + search if search else '') + ('&categoria=' + str(categoria_filter) if categoria_filter else '') + ('&ordenar=' + str(ordenar) if ordenar else '') + ('&limit=' + str(limit) if limit and limit != 12 else '') + '#entries_grid'

'/lugares-de-interes?page=' + str(page + 1) + ('&search=' + search if search else '') + ('&categoria=' + str(categoria_filter) if categoria_filter else '') + ('&ordenar=' + str(ordenar) if ordenar else '') + ('&limit=' + str(limit) if limit and limit != 12 else '') + '#entries_grid'
